snippet.title: Georgie-Yolkie 64 - The Furry Tale - Early Access Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
We are excited to announce that our newest title in the Georgie-Yolkie universe, GEORGIE-YOLKIE 64 is coming to Steam and GOG Early Access, along with Nintendo Switch 1/2 and XBOX!

Please note, footage is of a currently in-development product and is subject to change.

#zelda #switch2 #switch #n64 #n64games #retrogaming #indiegame
